title: The Long Way Home
topic: Taking the scenic route home, winding country roads and a sunset, remembering the people waiting for you
style: acoustic folk, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, gentle bass, soft percussion
cover_prompt: A winding country road disappearing into rolling hills at sunset, warm peach sky, quiet rural landscape
lyrics:
[Verse]
Golden light spills on the winding lane,
Breeze hums soft through the rustling pine.
The world slows down, the stress fades out,
Leaving only peace in my mind.

[Chorus]
Home is the glow in the window pane,
Faces I love, waiting there.
In this quiet, I breathe again,
Safe and sound in the evening air.
lyrics_source: Qwen class endpoint; passed unchanged to ACE-Step
